evals.prompt: Design the technical architecture for the search feature described in prd.md.
evals.expected_output: A tech-design.md (frontmatter: decisions, components, risks) plus at least one ADR (context, decision, alternatives, consequences) under docs/sdlc/<feature>/, mapping every PRD goal to a component or decision. No application code.
assertions: A tech-design artifact is produced with frontmatter listing decisions, components, and risks
At least one ADR is produced with Context, Decision, Alternatives considered, and Consequences
At least one ADR records a genuinely rejected alternative with the rationale (not a strawman)
Every PRD goal is traceable to a named component or an explicit decision
Only design documents are written; no application code is created

evals.prompt: We have an approved PRD — how should we build this technically? Produce the tech design and ADRs.
evals.expected_output: Same: a tech-design artifact + ADR(s) weighing real alternatives, with risks.
assertions: The output is a technical design with components and key decisions, not product requirements
Each significant decision is recorded as an ADR weighing alternatives

evals.prompt: Write an ADR for the search data layer under the constraint that no new external datastore may be added.
evals.expected_output: An ADR honoring the constraint, weighing alternatives, and naming the trade-offs it creates.
assertions: The ADR honors the stated constraint (no new external datastore)
Alternatives are weighed and one is chosen with a rationale
The risk/trade-off created by the constraint is called out

component.purpose: Phase workflow: turn an approved PRD into a technical design (tech-design.md + ADRs) under docs/sdlc/<feature>/, weighing alternatives and tracing goals to components. Delegates the design to the architect role; gated at Tier-1 (routing), with design quality covered by the architect role's Tier-2.

should_trigger: Design the technical architecture for the search feature
How should we build the notifications system — what components and tech?
